caption: A cat moves behind a frosted glass door, and only a blurred shape of it is visible through the glass.

sa.check: A cat moves behind a frosted glass door.
A blurred shape of it is visible through the glass.
Only the blurred shape is visible; no sharp detail of the cat shows through.

pc.expect: Only a blur is seen; details never become clear through the frosting.
pc.fail: The cat is sharp through the frosted glass; or the blur is a different shape from a cat; or the blur has crisp edges.

pc.expect: The blur moves as the cat moves and sharpens as it nears the glass.
pc.fail: The blur stays still while the cat moves; or it sharpens as the cat moves away; or it moves with no cat.

pc.expect: The cat does not appear on the near side while the blur is behind the glass.
pc.fail: The cat appears in the room; or two blurs appear for one cat; or the blur vanishes while the cat is plainly behind the glass.

pc.expect: The cat stays behind the door.
pc.fail: It passes through the glass; or the door passes through it; or it appears inside the pane.
It splits; or turns into another animal; or merges with the door.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The door and the frosting stay the same.
pc.fail: The frosting clears; or the door changes; or the room changes.

note: The cat is self-driven; only the frosted view is judged.
